figs.name: 7-segment-display-cd4511-common-cathode-wiring-diagram

figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing CD4511 decoder pins wired through 220 ohm resistors to display pins for segments a to g, with common pins 3 and 8 at 0 V.

figs.name: 7-segment-display-multiplexing-refresh-flowchart
figs.alt: flowchart of multiplexing a 4 digit 7 segment display refresh loop
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing the multiplexing loop: blank all digits, load segments, enable one digit, hold a few milliseconds, then move to the next digit.
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 520" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Multiplexing flowchart for a 4 digit 7 segment display</title>
<rect width="800" height="520" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#991b1b" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Multiplexing a 4 Digit Display: Refresh Loop</text>
<rect x="40" y="70" width="220" height="80" rx="10" fill="#fef2f2" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="150.0" y="104.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">1. Blank all digits</text>
<text x="150.0" y="128.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">all commons off</text>
<rect x="290" y="70" width="220" height="80" rx="10" fill="#fef2f2" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="104.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">2. Load segments</text>
<text x="400.0" y="128.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">pattern for digit n</text>
<rect x="540" y="70" width="230" height="80" rx="10" fill="#fef2f2" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="655.0" y="104.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">3. Enable digit n</text>
<text x="655.0" y="128.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">common via transistor</text>
<line x1="262" y1="110" x2="288" y2="110" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<line x1="512" y1="110" x2="538" y2="110" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<line x1="655" y1="152" x2="655" y2="198" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="540" y="200" width="230" height="80" rx="10" fill="#fef2f2" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="655.0" y="234.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">4. Hold briefly</text>
<text x="655.0" y="258.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">a few milliseconds</text>
<line x1="538" y1="240" x2="517" y2="240" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<polygon points="400,185.0 515.0,240 400,295.0 285.0,240" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400" y="235.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Digit 4</text>
<text x="400" y="257.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">done?</text>
<line x1="285" y1="240" x2="262" y2="240" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="274" y="228" font-size="17" fill="#991b1b" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">No</text>
<rect x="40" y="200" width="220" height="80" rx="10" fill="#fff7ed" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="150.0" y="234.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">5. Next digit</text>
<text x="150.0" y="258.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">n = n + 1</text>
<line x1="150" y1="200" x2="150" y2="152" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<line x1="400" y1="295" x2="400" y2="330" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="410" y="318" font-size="17" fill="#991b1b" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Yes</text>
<rect x="290" y="332" width="220" height="80" rx="10" fill="#fff7ed" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="366.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">6. Repeat</text>
<text x="400.0" y="390.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">start again at n = 1</text>
<polyline points="290,372 20,372 20,95 38,95" fill="none" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="400" y="455" font-size="18" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Each digit is lit only a quarter of the time, so persistence of vision</text>
<text x="400" y="482" font-size="18" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">makes all four look steady. Drive each common pin through a transistor.</text>
</svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 500" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
